annotation.title_clean: Executive Summary of the Impact Assessment Report: Proposal for a Regulation laying down harmonised rules on Artificial Intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act)
annotation.title_en: Executive Summary of the Impact Assessment Report: Proposal for a Regulation laying down harmonised rules on Artificial Intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act)
annotation.venue: European Commission Staff Working Document SWD(2021) 85 final
annotation.summary_en: Executive summary of the European Commission's impact assessment for the proposed AI Act. It sets out problems, objectives, policy options, stakeholder views and costs, and selects a horizontal risk-based regulation with mandatory requirements for high-risk AI and voluntary codes of conduct for other AI (Option 3+).
key_provisions_or_claims: Preferred option 3+: horizontal mandatory requirements for high-risk AI plus voluntary codes for non-high-risk AI
Compliance costs estimated at €100–500 million by 2025, about 4-5% of high-risk AI investment
Member States must designate supervisory authorities; 1–25 FTE each
SMEs supported via regulatory sandboxes and Digital Innovation Hubs
AI liability to be addressed through separate future rules; review five years after application
